text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can't wait until my next training
session.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You see, after I lost a race yesterday,
Sky was
kind enough to take me to a
park.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
While we were walking, I noticed all the
flowers at
our feet. The way they swayed
in the wind made it
look like they were
waving at us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They really helped me cheer up, both
the flowers
and Sky. So now I'm feeling
up to working
towards a comeback!
